reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the Kaschta et al. 2026 reanalysis batch for use-case-unresolved-rare-disease-reanalysis: 48 records (27 results, 5 claims of which 3 are relevance judgements, 5 evaluations, 3 configurations, 3 datasets, 3 protocols, 1 method, 1 source). The JATS XML re-downloaded to the pinned SHA-256. Every value was checked against its exact paragraph and quoted phrase with a separate parser; 26 results are source_checked and 1 is disputed (Talos total yield printed as 41.9%, contradicting its own sentence). The 3 judgements are source_checked with reviewed_evaluations (1 direct, 2 proxy); pins are not set. Details in docs/reviews/use-cases/unresolved-rare-disease-reanalysis-kaschta-2026-10-10.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review, not reproduction and not clinical validation.
All values are prose transcriptions; Table 1 (an image), the figures and the per-patient supplement were not read.
The source is a preprint whose licence reserves all rights; it is pinned by hash and not archived, so re-checking requires a new retrieval.
Pins for the 3 judgements are not set; the use case's assessed_by links, gap replacements and the replacement summary text are approved in the dated review but not applied here.
npm run build was not run, by instruction. npm test and npm run typecheck passed, and a scratch-store dry run of addBatch, loadRecords and deriveUseCaseInputs succeeded.

errors.message: Printed 41.9% contradicts its own sentence (158 to 161 cases, identical to the manual result; 161 of 377 is 42.7%). Status set to disputed; printed value kept.

Limitations added: the equal-input condition is not met, effort is measured in different units, the arms ran at different times, the manual reference cannot credit Talos-only findings, and Illumina supported the study. Yield and workload limitations rewritten.
Origin basis recorded: Illumina support on the manual arm; no Talos author among the study authors and the authors' ingestion adaptation on the Talos arm.
Recorded the 33 against 34 trio VUS case count and the per-case definition against per-variant reporting of concordance.
